title: Low-Degree Quasilinear Implicit Functions
summary: Low-degree implicit functions are known for small S-boxes and power mappings, but deciding existence and constructing low-degree quasilinear ones for arbitrary functions remain unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Low-degree implicit functions can be obtained for small S-boxes and power mappings. Given an arbitrary function, determine whether it admits a low-degree quasilinear implicit function and, if so, develop a method to construct one.

scope.domain: Implicit representations of Boolean and vectorial Boolean functions in white-box symmetric cryptography.
parameters: target function — an arbitrary function whose implicit representation is sought
degree — required to be low for the sought quasilinear implicit function
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether an arbitrary function admits a low-degree quasilinear implicit function and, when it does, develop a method to construct one.

citations.label: Implicit White-Box Implementations: White-Boxing ARX Ciphers

progress.summary: The source contrasts known methods for small S-boxes and power mappings with the hard existence-and-construction problem for arbitrary functions.
citation_labels: Adrián Ranea et al., Implicit White-Box Implementations: White-Boxing ARX Ciphers
